# Amazon Cap Prompts (EN) — 30 Full Prompts

Usage:
- Prompts 1–15 = **Group 1** (raised 3D digital print, more “print-like”)
- Prompts 16–30 = **Group 2** (stronger 3D embossed / UV print, thicker bas-relief)
- Each prompt is complete and can be pasted into a separate window.

---

## Prompt 01 (Group 1)

Base: A baseball cap front and center, perfectly centered, full cap visible (no cropping), Amazon listing hero shot. Viewing angle can vary per image: straight-on front view, slight left 3/4 tilt, or slight right 3/4 tilt (still product-forward, not extreme side). The cap occupies 70%+ of the frame. Real cotton twill/canvas fabric grain, matte cloth texture, natural brim curvature, realistic seams only as part of cap construction. Color palette can be bright and vibrant (not limited to dark tones), with crisp separation and sharp silhouette. Background can be colorful and diverse but must remain secondary (soft, defocused, non-distracting). Studio lighting with crisp rim light and realistic shadow under brim, shallow depth of field, 8K ultra-clear detail. No grids.
Print: On the crown front panel: slightly raised 3D digital print / low-profile thick ink deposit (NOT embroidery), matte soft-touch texture, subtle edge buildup with gentle height, soft shadowing and highlight falloff; overall remains print/coating-like with restrained relief (not heavy bas-relief).
Design: USA 250th Anniversary emblem. Bald eagle with spread wings as primary centerpiece; metallic badge-style embossed cross integrated behind the eagle’s chest crest; American flag stars-and-stripes flow as ribbon banners around the eagle. Typography: “1776–2026” and “250th Anniversary”, slightly curved, crisp and readable, thick-ink printed with lightly raised edges.
Variation: Clean solid deep navy background, soft gradient, subtle vignette.
Negative prompt: embroidery, embroidered, stitching, thread, knit texture, chenille, woven patch edges, fabric appliqué; flat sticker look, no thickness; blurry/garbled text, misspellings; candy-colored/rainbow backgrounds, chaotic neon noise; people, religious scenes/figures, churches, glowing “holy” imagery; flag overpowering the product; grids, checkerboards, grid lines; off-center cap, extreme side angles, heavy cropping.
